label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Backs DP World Tour
items.text: Rory McIlroy fully supports DP World Tour CEO Guy Kinnings' ban on LIV 2.0 players, accusing LIV Golf of trying to 'destroy' the European Tour and turning professional golf into an arms race.

items.headline: LPGA Toto Japan Classic Field
items.text: World No. 2 Jeeno Thitikul and Miyu Yamashita headline the LPGA Toto Japan Classic field at Taiheiyo Club Minori Course, with Shiho Kuwaki returning to LPGA play this week.
